transformations: Masks hold one channel in alpha; SDF atlases store signed distance in alpha, and WingSmokeSDF the distance to its lit tone in grey RGB. Colour and animation come from the native GLSL shaders.

assets.layout: single screaming soul, face at u 0.1-0.45 with its trail toward u 1
assets.transformation: mask (max of RGB x alpha) normalised, resized 256x128 -> 256x128

assets.use: Rancor soul trails and gathering streams
assets.transformation: mask (max of RGB x alpha), resized 512x256 -> 512x256

assets.layout: ring, brightest at 0.85 of the half size
assets.transformation: mask (max of RGB x alpha), resized 1024x1024 -> 512x512

assets.layout: fluffy smoke donut, densest at 0.39 of the half size
assets.transformation: mask (max of RGB x alpha), resized 512x512 -> 512x512
mask (max of RGB x alpha), resized 256x256 -> 256x256
mask (max of RGB x alpha), resized 256x256 -> 256x256

assets.layout: 9-frame toon fire blast, row-major in a 4x4 atlas
assets.transformation: signed distance atlas: 9 frames of a 3x3 flipbook, each fitted into 232px with 12px padding in a 256px cell of a 4x4 atlas; alpha 0.5 on the edge, +/-64px mapped to 1/0 (inside high)

assets.layout: 8-frame toon flame eruption rising from the cell bottom, row-major in a 4x2 atlas
assets.transformation: signed distance atlas: 8 frames of a 4x2 flipbook, each fitted into 232px with 12px padding in a 256px cell of a 4x2 atlas; alpha 0.5 on the edge, +/-64px mapped to 1/0 (inside high); frames anchored at the cell bottom
mask (max of RGB x alpha), resized 1024x512 -> 512x256

mask (max of RGB x alpha), resized 2048x2048 -> 512x512

assets.layout: 16-frame toon smoke puff (forming, billowing, breaking apart), row-major in a 4x4 atlas
assets.use: Wing Burst comet, take-off, wake, landing cloud and lingering haze
assets.transformation: two-channel signed distance atlas: 16 frames of a 4x4 flipbook, each fitted into 232px with 12px padding in a 256px cell of a 4x4 atlas; alpha holds the shape and grey RGB its lit tone (source grey above 0.8); 0.5 on the edge, +/-64px mapped to 1/0 (inside high)

revision: Second feedback round: WingSmokeSDF (toon smoke) replaces the lit SmokeBurst/SmokeLoop flipbooks; FogPuffs (density in alpha) replaces SmokePickbook (density in red); SlashToon is no longer used after Vanquish lost its slash.
